text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
After I worked so hard to train for this...
And I ran
so hard in the race today...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. This isn't the end!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! I gotta get back into the swing
of things!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I think only about the
next race! I'll
work harder than ever to
win it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it everything I have—full power
for total
victory! And then we'll both
smile and laugh!
Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're upset too... I see—it isn't just me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You mean use this frustration... to leap
forward?!
choice_data_list: この悔しさをバネにするぞ！
この悔しさをバネにしよう！

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll hold on tight to this feeling! And
then...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll make absolutely sure I never make
you feel
this way again!
